headlines.title: 国家统计局：上半年原材料制造业利润快速增长
headlines.summary: 上半年，规模以上原材料制造业利润同比增长71.7%，拉动全部规模以上工业企业利润增长8.8个百分点。从行业看，在铜、铝等有色金属产品需求向好等因素推动下，有色行业利润增长99.4%，拉动全部规模以上工业企业利润增长4.7个百分点；在石油产业链条相关产品价格上涨推动下，石油加工行业同比扭亏为盈，化工行业利润增长67.8%。

headlines.title: Price of parenting: the household maths giving China’s consumers pause

headlines.title: 国家统计局：上半年人工智能与各领域加速融合，算力需求大幅增长，推动电子行业利润同比增长96.9%
headlines.summary: 电子相关行业利润高速增长。上半年，人工智能与各领域加速融合，算力需求大幅增长，推动电子行业利润同比增长96.9%，拉动全部规模以上工业企业利润增长8.5个百分点，是规模以上工业企业利润较快增长的重要支撑。其中，服务器、高性能工作站相关领域中，计算机整机制造、计算机外围设备制造行业利润分别增长689.3%、305.8%；电子器件制造领域中，集成电路制造、半导体分立器件制造行业利润增长2579.5%、31.2%；电子元件及电子专用材料制造领域中，电子专用材料制造、电子电路制造行业利润增长209.7%、26.9%。

headlines.title_en: National Bureau of Statistics: AI integration across sectors accelerated in H1, with surging computing power demand driving a 96.9% year-on-year profit increase in the electronics industry
headlines.summary_en: Electronics-related profits surged. AI integration and soaring computing demand drove electronics industry profits up 96.9% YoY in H1, adding 8.5 ppt to total industrial profit growth. Key sub-sectors: computer manufacturing +689.3%, computer peripherals +305.8%, IC manufacturing +2579.5%, semiconductor discrete devices +31.2%, electronic materials +209.7%, circuit manufacturing +26.9%.

headlines.title: 光伏行业成本核算团体标准正式发布
headlines.summary: 日前，在国家市场监督管理总局、工业和信息化部指导下，由中国光伏行业协会牵头编制的团体标准《光伏行业成本核算模型通则》正式发布。本标准以企业会计准则为基础，通过统一“硅料—硅片—电池—组件”全产业链的成本计算范围、计算系数和计算模型，形成贯通产业链的成本核算框架，可破除行业内成本核算口径不一、各自表述的乱象。这是落实党中央、国务院关于规范市场竞争秩序、推动高质量发展部署的具体举措，也是光伏行业管理从自律倡议走向制度化、标准化的重要一步。

headlines.title_en: Group standard for photovoltaic industry cost accounting officially released
headlines.summary_en: The group standard 'Cost Accounting Model General Rules for the Photovoltaic Industry,' led by CPIA under the guidance of SAMR and MIIT, was released. Based on accounting standards, it unifies cost calculation scope, coefficients, and models across the silicon-wafer-cell-module chain to address inconsistent cost accounting practices. This is a concrete step to regulate market order and promote high-quality development, marking progress from self-discipline to institutionalized standards.

headlines.title_en: Research report nugget丨Guosheng Securities: maintains 'Buy' rating for CATL; diversified new businesses open growth potential
headlines.summary_en: Guosheng Securities: CATL's large dividends and buyback signal long-term confidence, with diversified new businesses opening growth space. 2026 H1 net profit attributable was 43.3 billion yuan, up 42.0% YoY; Q2 net profit 22.5 billion yuan, up 8.7% QoQ. Interim dividend of 14.11 yuan per 10 shares (6.493 billion yuan total, 15% of H1 net profit). Also plans to repurchase 20-40 billion yuan in A-shares for cancellation (0.75%-1.51% of total shares), boosting long-term growth confidence. H1 2026 battery system output 498 GWh, capacity utilization 94.9%. Current battery system capacity under construction 764 GWh, annualized capacity 1050 GWh, with new Times Resources Group to strengthen lithium-nickel-phosphorus integration.

headlines.summary: 上半年，规模以上原材料制造业利润同比增长71.7%，拉动全部规模以上工业企业利润增长8.8个百分点。从行业看，在铜、铝等有色金属产品需求向好等因素推动下，有色行业利润增长99.4%，拉动全部规模以上工业企业利润增长4.7个百分点；在石油产业链条相关产品价格上涨推动下，石油加工行业同比扭亏为盈，化工行业利润增长67.8%。
